# Manan Joshi — Developer Portfolio

> Hand-built, terminal-themed portfolio of Manan Joshi — first-year B.Tech CSE student at The NorthCap University (NCU), India. Self-taught Python, C++, C, JavaScript, HTML and CSS; builds tools for automation and games.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://manan.is-a.dev/): About, projects, skills, journey, contact
- [Trex Game](https://manan.is-a.dev/trex/): Playable T-Rex runner game built in JavaScript with p5.js
